findings.passage: I am honored to have the endorsement of Giffords. Their tireless work to make our communities safer and pass commonsense gun violence prevention laws is saving lives. Too recently we have seen the scourge of gun violence across our Commonwealth and nation. In Virginia’s Senate, I will build on the progress we’ve made and be a champion for gun violence prevention efforts.
findings.note: His statement, issued with a gun-safety group's endorsement for the 2023 special election for state Senate. Quoted in the group's press release, not on his own site.
